title: Redesigned icon
summary: A new icon that says what GI Helper does: a Genshin-style crystal star inside a glowing scan frame.

changes.text: New icon: a four-point crystal star (Genshin, and the familiar AI sparkle) framed by a glowing scanner viewfinder.
The same icon now appears everywhere: browser tab, home screen, top bar, the scanner heading and the share image.
Sharper browser tab icon at small sizes.
